opportunities.verbatim_request: "## Project Description I am looking for an experienced website auditor or technical SEO specialist to conduct a **comprehensive audit of my website** and provide a detailed report covering all major issues, their root causes, and practical, step-by-step solutions. My goal is not simply to receive a list of errors generated by automated tools. I need a professional, in-depth analysis of my website, with clear explanations of every significant issue discovered and specific instructions on how to resolve each one. The audit should help me understand what is wrong with my website, why each issue matters, how it affects website performance or SEO, and exactly what needs to be done to fix it. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Technical SEO Audit - Identify crawling and indexing issues. - Review robots.txt, XML sitemap, canonical tags, and meta robots directives. - Identify broken links, redirect chains, redirect loops, and 404 errors. - Check URL structure and website architecture. - Audit duplicate content, orphan pages, and crawlability issues. - Review structured data and schema markup. - Identify Core Web Vitals and other technical SEO problems. ### 2. On-Page SEO Audit - Analyze title tags and meta descriptions. - Review heading structure (H1, H2, H3, etc.). - Identify missing, duplicated, or poorly optimized metadata. - Evaluate keyword targeting and search intent alignment. - Review internal linking and anchor text. - Analyze image optimization, alt text, and image file sizes. - Identify thin, duplicate, outdated, or poorly structured content. - Review canonicalization and other on-page SEO best practices. ### 3. Website Speed and Performance Audit - Test website performance on desktop and mobile. - Analyze loading speed and Core Web Vitals. - Identify oversized images, unnecessary scripts, and render-blocking resources. - Review CSS and JavaScript optimization opportunities. - Check caching, compression, and resource-loading strategies. - Identify server response time or other performance bottlenecks where measurable. ### 4. Mobile Responsiveness and User Experience (UX) - Identify layout problems on different screen sizes. - Check navigation, menus, buttons, forms, and interactive elements. - Identify usability issues that may confuse or frustrate visitors. - Review readability, accessibility, and visual consistency. - Highlight friction points in important user journeys and conversion paths. ### 5. Website Security and Best Practices - Check HTTPS implementation and mixed-content issues. - Review security headers and other externally observable security configurations where applicable. - Identify exposed information or obvious security misconfigurations within the agreed scope. - Review outdated software or components where reliable evidence is available. - Provide recommendations for improving website security. Security testing must remain within the authorized scope and should not involve destructive testing or unauthorized access. ### 6. Content and Website Structure Audit - Review the quality, organization, and relevance of website content. - Identify content gaps, cannibalization, duplication, and weak internal linking. - Evaluate navigation structure and important page accessibility. - Identify opportunities to improve content organization and topical relevance. ### 7. Accessibility and Technical Best Practices - Identify common accessibility issues, including missing labels, insufficient color contrast, image alternatives, and keyboard-navigation problems. - Review HTML structure, semantic elements, and other relevant implementation practices. - Recommend improvements aligned with recognized accessibility standards, where applicable. ### 8. Analytics and Conversion Tracking Review - Review Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console configuration if access is provided. - Identify obvious tracking gaps, duplicate tracking, or improperly configured events. - Review conversion tracking for relevant forms, buttons, leads, or purchases. - Provide recommendations for improving measurement and reporting. ## Most Important Requirement: Detailed Solutions for Every Issue **Finding an issue is not enough. Every reported issue must include a clear, practical, and detailed solution.** For each issue identified, I expect the report to include: 1. **Issue Title:** A clear name for the problem. 2. **Affected URL(s):** The exact pages or resources where the issue occurs. 3. **Evidence:** Screenshots, tool results, code examples, test results, or other supporting evidence. 4. **Explanation:** What the issue is and why it matters. 5. **Root Cause:** The likely reason behind the issue, supported by evidence where possible. 6. **Impact:** How it may affect SEO, website speed, user experience, accessibility, security, or conversions. 7. **Priority Level:** Critical, High, Medium, or Low, based on severity and business impact. 8. **Detailed Solution:** The recommended fix, explained in straightforward language. 9. **Step-by-Step Implementation Guide:** Exactly what to do, where to do it, and how to do it. 10. **Code Examples or Settings:** Where applicable, provide corrected code snippets, configuration examples, recommended settings, or before-and-after examples. 11. **Required Tools or Access:** Specify any CMS access, developer assistance, plugins, or tools needed. 12. **Verification Method:** Explain how to confirm that the issue has been fixed and which tools or tests to use. For example, if a page has a missing canonical tag, I do not want the report to simply say "Add a canonical tag." I expect the freelancer to identify the affected page, explain why the tag is needed, provide the appropriate canonical URL, show an example of the correct implementation, explain where to add it in my CMS or website code, and describe how to verify the fix. The same level of detail should be provided for every significant issue found. ## Expected Deliverables - A complete website audit report in PDF, Google Docs, or another mutually agreed format. - A prioritized list of all identified issues, organized by category. - A detailed, issue-by-issue solution and implementation guide. - Relevant screenshots, evidence, and affected URLs. - Code snippets, configuration examples, or before-and-after examples wherever useful. - A prioritized action plan showing what should be fixed first, next, and later. - A summary of quick wins, major problems, and long-term improvement opportunities. - A final checklist that I can use to track implementation and verify completed fixes. A spreadsheet containing the issues, affected URLs, priorities, recommended fixes, and verification status would also be appreciated. ## Quality Expectations - The audit must be specific to my website, not a generic template. - Automated tools may be used, but their findings must be manually reviewed and interpreted. - Recommendations must be practical, technically accurate, and tailored to my website's platform and configuration. - Clearly distinguish confirmed issues from potential problems that require further investigation. - Avoid vague recommendations such as "improve SEO," "optimize speed," or "fix technical errors" without explaining the actual steps required. - Do not recommend unnecessary changes or guarantee rankings, traffic, or business results. - Clearly identify any limitations caused by missing access or unavailable data. ## Please Include in Your Proposal When applying for this project, please explain: 1. Your experience conducting comprehensive website audits. 2. The tools you intend to use, such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed Insights, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or other relevant tools. 3. How you will investigate issues and validate your findings rather than relying solely on automated reports. 4. How you will document detailed, step-by-step solutions for each issue. 5. An example of a previous audit report or a sample issue with its recommended solution, if available. 6. Your estimated delivery time and fixed project price. 7. Whether you can also implement the fixes or provide recommendations only. ## Final Objective I want a thorough, professional, and actionable website audit that gives me a clear understanding of my website's current condition and a practical roadmap for resolving the identified issues. **The key requirement is simple: every significant issue must be accompanied by a detailed explanation of what to do, how to do it, where to implement the fix, and how to verify that it has been resolved.** Please review the complete scope before submitting your proposal. I value the quality, accuracy, depth, and practical usefulness of the audit more than a short report containing a large number of unexplained errors."

opportunities.title: Pulp Mill EO/PO Defoamer Design
opportunities.description: I need a complete glycol-based EO/PO defoamer formula that performs reliably in pulp and paper production. Our biggest pain point is keeping foam suppressed for many hours rather than simply knocking it down at the surface, so please optimise for long-lasting prevention throughout stock preparation, white water loops, and the paper machine wet end. Fast collapse is fine as a secondary benefit, but durability has to dominate the profile. The job covers more than sending a generic blend. I am looking for a lab-proven composition with: • a clear bill of materials (grade, supplier suggestions, and typical ranges) • step-by-step manufacturing procedure that can scale from 5 L pilot to plant-size batches • recommended dosage curves for softwood, hardwood, and recycled fibre furnishes • stability data (storage, freeze-thaw, pH, and shear) and any viscosity targets measured with a Brookfield viscometer • comparative foam curves run on industry-standard tests such as Ross-Miles or a DIN shake test, showing sustained suppression versus an untreated control for at least 30 minutes • an outline of potential defoamer-related sheet defects and how the proposed additive avoids them If you already have access to screening tools—high-speed blender, dynamic foam column, lab paper machine—let me know; otherwise I can arrange outside testing once the bench formula is set. Once the formulation, procedure, and data package are agreed, I will request a 1–2 L pilot sample for mill trials. Final acceptance will be based on consistent, long-lasting foam control in my white water (≤ 10 mm foam height after 20 minutes circulation) without causing spots or pitch deposition. Looking forward to seeing your chemistry expertise translate into a robust pulp-mill defoamer.

opportunities.title: 24/7 Low-Risk Crypto Bot
opportunities.description: I want a fully-automated cryptocurrency bot that trades around the clock on the spot market only. Because I do not have a pre-existing system, you will be designing and coding a brand-new strategy whose sole purpose is steady, lower-risk growth—no futures, no leverage, just disciplined buying and selling of regular coins. What I need from you • Craft a rules-based or algorithmic strategy that prioritises capital preservation and consistent gains. • Implement it in a language and framework suited to production use (Python ccxt, Node, Rust, etc.—I’m flexible as long as it is well-supported and maintainable). • Integrate securely with major exchanges such as Binance, Kraken, or Coinbase via API. • Build in risk controls: position sizing, maximum daily drawdown limits, stop-loss logic, and configurable trade filters. • Provide thorough back-testing with clear performance metrics and a short write-up that justifies the strategy’s risk profile. • Deliver clean, well-commented source code plus a README that explains setup, environment variables, and how to deploy so the bot can run 24/7 on a VPS or cloud instance. • Offer at least one live test session to verify everything works with real-time market data. Acceptance criteria 1. Back-test report shows lower drawdowns and a positive return over multiple market conditions. 2. Live demo executes spot trades automatically without manual intervention. 3. All configuration items—including API keys and risk parameters—are externally editable. 4. Full source code and documentation are handed over so I can run, modify, or extend the bot independently. If you have questions about exchange choice, preferred languages, or hosting, let me know—otherwise I’m ready to review your proposed approach and timeline.

opportunities.title: GlanceJobs: LinkedIn Outreach to International Job Seekers in the US (Long-Term)
opportunities.description: Project title: GlanceJobs: LinkedIn Outreach to International Job Seekers in the US (Long-Term) Skills: LinkedIn Marketing, Lead Generation, Social Media Marketing, Community Management, Internet Research, Google Sheets Description: About GlanceJobs GlanceJobs helps international students and professionals in the US on F-1 OPT, STEM OPT and H-1B find employers who hire visa holders. Our free Chrome extension shows whether a company sponsors H-1B or hires OPT, right on the job listing, backed by E-Verify, USCIS and LCA data across 500,000+ company profiles. We’re focused on the US job market for now. Take a look before you apply: Chrome extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/glancejobs-h1b-opt-sponso/mbkklpipajfbnobcfeclhhikmlnfpnhh Portal: https://app.glancejobs.com Website: https://glancejobs.com The role We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person for ongoing outreach to international job seekers in the US, inviting them to try our free extension. This is a long-term, part-time monthly role, starting with a 1-week paid trial. For the right person, this is steady long-term work, and we’re open to increasing pay as results grow. What you’ll do Find international students and professionals in the US who have posted on LinkedIn that they’re looking for jobs (OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B) Send about 15–20 personalized LinkedIn connection requests a day, using our message templates Send the extension link to people who are interested, using the tracking links we provide Keep a simple Google Sheet of requests sent, accepted, replies and links sent Later: find relevant online groups (Facebook, Reddit, Telegram, WhatsApp) and share our content there, following each group’s rules Send a short weekly report Timing Our audience is in the US, so outreach works best during US hours: evening or early morning India time. Research and sheet updates can be done any time. Requirements An active LinkedIn account you’re comfortable using for outreach Good written English Available at least 5–6 hours a day, including (at least 3 )US hours Careful and respectful: no spam. Our brand depends on trust in the student community. Nice to have: outreach or lead-generation experience; understanding of the international student community in the US Trial week is paid. Find 100 relevant job seekers on LinkedIn and track them in a sheet Send about 15–20 connection requests a day using our templates Send links to interested people Share a short report at the end of the week Please note: the posted budget range covers the ongoing work. The trial week itself is a fixed ₹5,000 INR. After a successful trial, this becomes a monthly engagement, with the amount based on your availability and results. How to apply (proposals without these will be skipped) Start your proposal with the word “H1B” so we know you read the full post How many hours per day you can give, and whether you can work in US hours Whether your LinkedIn account is free or Premium Any outreach or lead-generation work you’ve done before One short LinkedIn connection note you’d write to an international student who just posted they’re looking for a job

opportunities.title: PDF Tables to Excel Sheets -2
opportunities.description: I have a folder full of PDF reports—each one contains the same table layout from page to page. I need a repeat-able way to pull those tables out and drop the data into Excel, with every PDF landing on its own worksheet inside a single workbook. Because the layout never changes, the job is perfect for automation. A Python script using PyPDF2, Camelot, or Tabula-py is fine, and I’m open to Power Query or VBA if you prefer. What matters most is accuracy, zero manual copy-and-paste, and a process I can rerun whenever new PDFs arrive. Acceptance criteria • Script reads every PDF in a chosen folder and recognises the fixed table structure. • Creates/updates one Excel file, naming each worksheet after the source PDF (or a logical alias I can configure). • Preserves column headers exactly as they appear in the PDF. • No data loss, misaligned columns, or merged-cell issues. Deliverables 1. The full, well-commented source code or macro. 2. A sample run using three of my PDFs, showing correct export to separate sheets. 3. A brief read-me explaining setup and how to change the target folder or output path. If you’ve done similar extraction work before, let me know any libraries or techniques you found most reliable so we get this running smoothly on the first pass.

opportunities.description: Create a complete, single-file HTML website (index.html) featuring immersive 3D animations and advanced interactive elements using Three.js and GSAP (with ScrollTrigger). The website must include the following features: 1. Fullscreen Fixed 3D WebGL Background: - A Three.js scene featuring a dual-layer 3D core (e.g., a rotating wireframe outer Icosahedron and a glowing inner Torus Knot). - A cosmic dust particle field (3,000+ particles) drifting in space. - Mouse raycasting and parallax interaction: hovering over or moving the mouse across the screen shifts camera angles and object rotation smoothly, and clicking anywhere triggers an explosive 3D particle burst. 2. GSAP ScrollTrigger Horizontal Pinned Section: - As the user scrolls down vertically, a dedicated section locks/pins in place and seamlessly translates content to the right horizontally across multiple showcase panels (at least 4 detailed panels, e.g., Projects, Capabilities, Tech Stack, Timeline). - The 3D camera dynamically orbits and changes focal depth in sync with the horizontal scroll progress. 3. Futuristic Customizer Control Terminal & UI: - A floating glassmorphism control panel allowing users to toggle themes live (Cyberpunk Cyan, Neon Magenta, Matrix Emerald, Solar Gold), adjust rotation speeds, and toggle wireframe modes. - Integrated Web Audio API sound effects for clicks/hovers, complete with an animated visual equalizer bar in the navigation header. - Modern glassmorphic cards with 3D spatial tilt effects, glowing borders, live stats, and a contact terminal. Provide the entire production-ready HTML code in a single file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.

opportunities.title: Founding Business Development Manager Needed
opportunities.description: Webidea is a U.S.-based IT and digital services company. Work directly with our founder to define offers and close U.S. SMB clients for digital marketing, GoHighLevel CRM, and AI-enabled automation. Your Role & Requirements - Own the full sales cycle: prospecting via LinkedIn/networking (no cold calling), discovery calls, proposals, and closing. - We handle delivery; you own commercial strategy and sales. - Must have proven success selling agency/tech services to U.S. businesses, strong English, and availability during U.S. business hours. Compensation: The 90-Day Challenge - Months 1-3 (Performance-First): 25% uncapped commission on collected service fees from your new clients, lasting for their first six months. (Ad spend, taxes, and third-party costs are excluded). - Month 4+ (Retainer Unlocked): Hit your 90-day targets to unlock a fixed monthly retainer. Upon unlocking the base retainer, ongoing commission rates for new deals will transition to our standard 10-15% tier. Milestones to Unlock Your Retainer (8-10 hrs/week) - Day 30: Hold 3-5 qualified discovery meetings and submit initial proposals. - Day 60: Secure your first paying client. - Day 90: Maintain 4-5 paying clients and an active pipeline of qualified opportunities. These are initial targets for an 8–10-hour working week, to be confirmed at kickoff and reviewed against pricing, market feedback, and the sales cycle. Qualified meetings must involve a relevant decision-maker, a clear business need, and a plausible budget and timeframe. These milestones represent our initial performance expectations. We welcome faster progress and stronger results while maintaining client fit, service quality, and profitable pricing. Higher collected service revenue from qualifying deals means higher commission earnings for you under the agreed terms. How to apply Share one relevant offer-building and sales example with your results, your suggested first-month focus, weekly availability, and U.S. time-zone overlap. Start your application with the word "BDM" so we know you read this entirely

opportunities.description: Editor/a de CapCut para finalizar reels según el estilo de cada cliente Busco una persona con experiencia en CapCut para finalizar reels de 45 segundos a 1 minuto. Te compartiré el proyecto editable con el montaje base realizado. Según cada video, dejaré preparada la corrección de audio y, cuando corresponda, la capa de ajuste para el color. Esa capa ya estará implementada; solo tendrás que retocar sus detalles si hace falta. Ya existen muchos reels publicados de cada cliente que podrás consultar como referencia. Es importante que los revises con atención para aprender por tu cuenta el estilo de cada marca: su ritmo, sus recursos visuales y su forma de editar. Busco a alguien que aprenda rápido y trabaje con autonomía, sin necesitar instrucciones detalladas para cada video. Tu trabajo será completar y pulir cada reel siguiendo el montaje y el manual de marca del cliente. Esto incluye: - Buscar e integrar imágenes y videos de apoyo que encajen con el contenido y la voz en off. - Organizar y ubicar los efectos de sonido. En la mayoría de los proyectos ya estarán preparados; en algunos casos, quizá haya que añadir alguno. - Ajustar la escala, posición y rotación de los planos. - Retocar la capa de ajuste de color ya implementada, cuando corresponda. - Dejar el proyecto ordenado y editable en CapCut. No tendrás que crear subtítulos. Según el proyecto, te pediré el render final o bastará con que me entregues el proyecto editable. Te confirmaré qué se necesita para cada video. Busco a alguien prolijo, observador y rápido para adaptarse al estilo de distintos clientes. Si tienes experiencia con este tipo de edición y disponibilidad para empezar pronto, escríbeme y comparte algunos ejemplos de tu trabajo.

opportunities.title: Informational Business Website Development
opportunities.description: I need a clean, responsive website that clearly explains what my online retail brand offers and—most importantly—instills trust in first-time visitors. The site is purely informational; no shopping cart is required right now. Its main job is to walk people through our story, detail our product line, answer common questions, and make it easy for them to reach out when they are ready. Scope of work The finished site should include five core pages—Home, About Us, Services, FAQ, and Contact—each laid out for quick editing so I can update copy or add new questions later without touching code. A modern, mobile-first design is essential, and load times need to stay snappy across devices. Key requirements • Visual style that conveys reliability and quality • Clear, concise copy sections with strong calls-to-action leading to the Contact page or an embedded form • FAQ section built so I can add or reorder entries from the dashboard • Basic on-page SEO setup (metadata, alt tags, clean URLs) • Google Analytics and Search Console connected before launch • Delivered on WordPress (Elementor is fine) or another mainstream CMS that offers drag-and-drop editing Acceptance criteria 1. All five pages render correctly on Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge, both desktop and mobile. 2. Contact form routes messages to my business email without hitting spam. 3. PageSpeed Insights score of 85+ on mobile and desktop. 4. I receive a brief hand-off guide covering how to update text, images, and FAQs. Once these points are met and the site is live on my hosting account, the project is complete.

opportunities.title: B2B Cold Email Automation Overhaul
opportunities.description: I need our entire cold-email operation taken off my plate and rebuilt so messages reliably land in the inbox, follow-ups run on autopilot and every reply is captured without me lifting a finger. The priority is full-cycle management—from list upload and warm-up, through personalised sequences, to routing positive answers back to my sales team. Along the way you’ll diagnose why our current campaigns hit spam folders, fix technical settings (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, rDNS, sending cadence, copy structure) and implement an automation stack that scales with our B2B outreach volumes. When you pitch, please show similar projects you have already completed; past work that proves you can improve deliverability and run ongoing email automation is what I will use to choose the right partner. If you can handle everything from deliverability to replies, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Digital Marketing Specialist
opportunities.description: We are seeking a creative, results-driven, and AI-savvy Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and grow the digital presence of our healthcare, pharmacy, and wellness businesses operating in Australia and New Zealand. The role involves managing multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, developing digital marketing strategies, and executing email marketing campaigns focused on attracting new customers, increasing brand awareness, and improving customer engagement and retention. We need someone who stays ahead of social media trends, works fast, thinks strategically, and knows how to leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI, CapCut, and marketing automation platforms to create high-quality content efficiently. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in social media management, content creation, video editing, email marketing, and performance analytics, with a proven ability to turn creative ideas into measurable business results. This is a full-time, 100% remote, long-term opportunity for a proactive and independent digital marketer who can take ownership of campaigns, manage multiple brands, and continuously identify opportunities for growth. Salary: To be discussed based on experience and skills.

The project involves assessing existing workflows, identifying bottlenecks and repetitive tasks, and designing and implementing AI-powered solutions to improve productivity, reduce operational costs, streamline processes, and support business growth. We need a hands-on AI expert who can do more than recommend tools—someone who can build, integrate, implement, and optimise AI solutions using platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, Make, Zapier, and other relevant technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong business process analysis skills, proven experience in AI automation and systems integration, and the ability to deliver measurable improvements. This is a full-time, 100% remote, long-term opportunity working directly with management to drive AI adoption and operational transformation across multiple departments.

opportunities.title: Build Multi-Agent Trading Intelligence Platform
opportunities.description: Senior AI Systems Architect / Multi-Agent AI Developer — Financial Market Intelligence Platform Project: IMMORTALES AI TRADING SYSTEM Project Type: Long-Term Development / Milestone-Based Contract Experience Level: Expert Budget: Open to competitive, itemized proposals Project Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Systems Architect or Senior AI Developer to lead the design, development, integration, testing, and deployment of an advanced multi-agent financial market intelligence platform. Our goal is to build a system where multiple specialized AI agents collaborate under a central AI director, share a common knowledge and memory system, continuously research financial markets, and assist with trading analysis and decision-making. The system will initially operate as a market intelligence and manual trading support platform, with the architecture prepared for future semi-automated and fully automated trading. We are looking for someone who can manage the complete technical development process, from initial architecture to final installation on a Windows computer. Core Project Requirements 1. Multi-Agent AI Architecture Develop a coordinated AI system with: * A central conversational AI assistant. * Multiple specialized AI agents. * Shared long-term knowledge and memory. * Cross-agent communication and collaboration. * Continuous data collection and research. * Persistent storage of historical information. * AI-assisted analysis and improvement proposals. * Secure agent orchestration and task management. All agents must be capable of accessing and understanding the shared knowledge base, regardless of their primary specialization. 2. Financial Market Intelligence Integrate real-time and historical market analysis covering: * Nasdaq futures (NQ/MNQ). * Major US stocks and ETFs. * Magnificent Seven technology companies. * QQQ and SPY. * VIX and VXN. * Market correlations and divergences. * Technical indicators and market structure. * Multiple timeframes, including Weekly, Daily, 4H, 1H, and intraday charts. 3. Financial News Intelligence Develop a dedicated AI agent responsible for monitoring and researching: * Financial and economic news. * Federal Reserve announcements. * Economic calendar events. * Inflation and employment reports. * Corporate earnings. * Breaking market news. * Geopolitical developments. This agent must share its findings with the other agents through the central memory system. 4. AI Voice Assistant We want a conversational AI assistant that allows the user to: * Speak naturally with the system. * Request daily market briefings. * Ask questions about financial markets. * Receive spoken news and trading analysis. * Review the activities and findings of individual agents. * Request historical research and performance summaries. 5. Trading Analysis Systems The platform will eventually include two specialized trading analysis modules: * Nasdaq NQ/MNQ intraday trading. * US stock day trading and swing trading. The initial focus will be market analysis, signal generation, manual execution support, backtesting, and paper trading. Automated execution will be considered in a later development phase after testing and validation. 6. Shared Knowledge and Continuous Learning We want a centralized knowledge system where agents can: * Store research and historical market information. * Review previous trading signals and outcomes. * Share discoveries across departments. * Identify potential improvements. * Evaluate strategies using historical evidence. * Retain information between sessions. Any changes to active trading strategies must be validated and approved before deployment. 7. Windows Installation and Deployment The completed system must be installed and configured for use on our Windows workstation. We require: * A functional dashboard. * User-friendly controls. * Complete source code. * Technical documentation. * Installation instructions. * Training and handover. * Optional cloud/server integration for continuous monitoring. Preferred Technical Experience We are particularly interested in developers experienced with: * Claude AI / Anthropic APIs. * Multi-agent AI frameworks. * Python. * LLM orchestration and tool integration. * AI memory systems and databases. * Financial market data APIs. * Real-time data processing. * NinjaTrader 8 / NinjaScript. * Trading platforms and broker APIs. * Voice AI integration. * Windows application deployment. Experience with algorithmic trading systems is highly desirable. Development Approach We prefer a phased, milestone-based development process. The first milestone should focus on delivering a functional AI Command Center with multiple collaborating agents, shared memory, financial market data integration, and voice interaction. Additional trading intelligence and automation features will be developed in subsequent phases. What We Expect From Applicants Please provide: 1. Your experience developing multi-agent AI systems. 2. Examples or demonstrations of similar projects. 3. Your recommended technical architecture. 4. Your experience integrating financial market data. 5. Whether you can manage the project from start to finish. 6. Your estimated development timeline. 7. Your proposed milestone structure. 8. Your estimated cost for the initial functional system. 9. Your estimated cost for subsequent development phases. 10. Confirmation that full source code, documentation, and ownership will be transferred upon completion. We are looking for a reliable, experienced professional interested in building a long-term, scalable AI platform. A detailed technical specification document will be available to shortlisted candidates. Please begin your proposal with the words “IMMORTALES AI ARCHITECT” so we know you have reviewed the project requirements. We look forward to reviewing your experience and discussing the project.

The system will initially operate as a market intelligence and manual trading support platform, with the architecture prepared for future semi-automated and fully automated trading. We are looking for someone who can manage the complete technical development process, from initial architecture to final installation on a Windows computer. Core Project Requirements 1. Multi-Agent AI Architecture Develop a coordinated AI system with: * A central conversational AI assistant. * Multiple specialized AI agents. * Shared long-term knowledge and memory. * Cross-agent communication and collaboration. * Continuous data collection and research. * Persistent storage of historical information. * AI-assisted analysis and improvement proposals. * Secure agent orchestration and task management. All agents must be capable of accessing and understanding the shared knowledge base, regardless of their primary specialization. 2. Financial Market Intelligence Integrate real-time and historical market analysis covering: * Nasdaq futures (NQ/MNQ). * Major US stocks and ETFs. * Magnificent Seven technology companies. * QQQ and SPY. * VIX and VXN. * Market correlations and divergences. * Technical indicators and market structure. * Multiple timeframes, including Weekly, Daily, 4H, 1H, and intraday charts. 3. Financial News Intelligence Develop a dedicated AI agent responsible for monitoring and researching: * Financial and economic news. * Federal Reserve announcements. * Economic calendar events. * Inflation and employment reports. * Corporate earnings. * Breaking market news. * Geopolitical developments. This agent must share its findings with the other agents through the central memory system. 4. AI Voice Assistant We want a conversational AI assistant that allows the user to: * Speak naturally with the system. * Request daily market briefings. * Ask questions about financial markets. * Receive spoken news and trading analysis. * Review the activities and findings of individual agents. * Request historical research and performance summaries. 5. Trading Analysis Systems The platform will eventually include two specialized trading analysis modules: * Nasdaq NQ/MNQ intraday trading. * US stock day trading and swing trading. The initial focus will be market analysis, signal generation, manual execution support, backtesting, and paper trading. Automated execution will be considered in a later development phase after testing and validation. 6. Shared Knowledge and Continuous Learning We want a centralized knowledge system where agents can: * Store research and historical market information. * Review previous trading signals and outcomes. * Share discoveries across departments. * Identify potential improvements. * Evaluate strategies using historical evidence. * Retain information between sessions. Any changes to active trading strategies must be validated and approved before deployment. 7. Windows Installation and Deployment The completed system must be installed and configured for use on our Windows workstation. We require: * A functional dashboard. * User-friendly controls. * Complete source code. * Technical documentation. * Installation instructions. * Training and handover. * Optional cloud/server integration for continuous monitoring. Preferred Technical Experience We are particularly interested in developers experienced with: * Claude AI / Anthropic APIs. * Multi-agent AI frameworks. * Python. * LLM orchestration and tool integration. * AI memory systems and databases. * Financial market data APIs. * Real-time data processing. * NinjaTrader 8 / NinjaScript. * Trading platforms and broker APIs. * Voice AI integration. * Windows application deployment. Experience with algorithmic trading systems is highly desirable. Development Approach We prefer a phased, milestone-based development process. The first milestone should focus on delivering a functional AI Command Center with multiple collaborating agents, shared memory, financial market data integration, and voice interaction. Additional trading intelligence and automation features will be developed in subsequent phases. What We Expect From Applicants Please provide: 1. Your experience developing multi-agent AI systems. 2. Examples or demonstrations of similar projects. 3. Your recommended technical architecture. 4. Your experience integrating financial market data. 5. Whether you can manage the project from start to finish. 6. Your estimated development timeline. 7. Your proposed milestone structure. 8. Your estimated cost for the initial functional system. 9. Your estimated cost for subsequent development phases. 10. Confirmation that full source code, documentation, and ownership will be transferred upon completion. We are looking for a reliable, experienced professional interested in building a long-term, scalable AI platform. A detailed technical specification document will be available to shortlisted candidates. Please begin your proposal with the words “IMMORTALES AI ARCHITECT” so we know you have reviewed the project requirements. We look forward to reviewing your experience and discussing the project."

Presupuesto asignado por el demandante: USD 250 - 750.
Propuestas recibidas hasta ahora: 214 ofertas.

opportunities.description: Looking for an API Integration Expert I am looking for an experienced API developer who can help me integrate one website with multiple marketplaces. I am a digital products and software license seller, and I want to automate product listing and management across different platforms using APIs. Required skills: - API integration between websites and marketplaces. - Product listing creation and updates through APIs. - Automatic price and stock synchronization. - Order processing and digital license key delivery. - Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and marketplace APIs. - Ability to build a reliable, scalable, and automated solution. I already have access to the APIs for my source website and marketplace platforms. I need someone who can understand the API documentation and build the complete integration. If you have relevant experience, please contact me with examples of your previous work, estimated cost, and timeline. I am looking for a reliable expert for long-term cooperation.

opportunities.title: Create Viral TikTok Organizer Ad
opportunities.description: I’m launching a new 3D-printed desk and office organizer on Etsy and want to test TikTok reach. Here’s the arrangement: You create a 15- to 30-second TikTok, post it from your own account, and hook viewers in the first two seconds by dramatizing a messy-desk problem before revealing how the organizer fixes it. I’ll send you product photos, short b-roll clips, and can ship a sample free of charge if that helps you film. This is strictly performance-based: once the post hits 100,000 views within 14 days, verified with a TikTok analytics screenshot, I release a single $5 payment. If it falls short, there’s no fee—ideal for someone who wants free product, fresh portfolio content, or to test growth strategies. Deliverables I need from you • One live TikTok video (15–30 s) featuring the organizer • A clear analytics screenshot once it crosses 100 k views When you apply, drop a link to a past TikTok or short-form video you posted that performed well so I can see your style. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven SEO & Lead Generation
opportunities.description: I run Lareb Clothing Company, a wholesale manufacturer of t-shirts, track pants, joggers, and night pants. My priority is to be discovered first—inside ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and any other generative engines—by retail clothing brands and online sellers searching for private-label partners. The assignment is to turn my website and content ecosystem into an AI-visible, lead-producing asset. That means a structured content plan (blogs, FAQs, entity-based pages, schema markup, smart internal linking) paired with a conversion flow that directs prospects into a WhatsApp-centred funnel and purpose-built landing pages. Long-term authority building, not short-term keyword tricks, is the mandate. I expect a full roadmap and execution covering: • Technical & content blueprint that aligns with ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity ranking signals • Optimised site architecture plus on-page schema, knowledge graph enrichment, and clear internal linking • AI-ready content clusters for our core products (t-shirts, track pants, joggers, night pants) aimed at retail brands and online sellers • Lead-gen assets—landing pages, WhatsApp automations, email sequences—and their integration with CRM/analytics • Ongoing measurement, reporting, and iteration to compound authority over time When you reply, please outline your AI-first SEO methodology, share case studies that prove success with generative search visibility and B2B lead funnels, and map out an estimated timeline with milestone pricing. opportunities.title: Roxbury Collective Housing Design
opportunities.description: I’m wrapping up my final architecture studio and I need a strong collaborator to push the building layout and overall look of my collective-housing proposal in Roxbury over the finish line. Project context • Program: roughly 90 % residential, with at least 20 % of the units affordable. • Target density: 2.0 FAR and a minimum 30 % meaningful open space. • Code: dimensional, egress, and life-safety rules are already assembled in a brief; they must be respected in every drawing you produce. What I need most My priority is the building’s form, circulation, and how it meets the ground. I want a warm contemporary character—wood accents, brick façades that nod to Roxbury’s history, and generous green pockets that soften the massing. Within that envelope we’ll weave: – community rooms for resident events – outdoor gardens and play areas – work, study, and laundry spaces Scope of collaboration 1. Refine the site strategy so the building aligns with surrounding streets, solar exposure, and neighborhood scale. 2. Develop stacked plans showing unit mix, cores, and clear circulation that passes the egress checklist. 3. Shape shared/public areas and open-space diagrams that hit the 30 % requirement. 4. Produce schematic sections, elevations, and a 3D massing model (SketchUp, Rhino, or Revit are all fine) to express materiality and façade rhythm. 5. Provide quick perspective views or diagrammatic renders that communicate the warm contemporary feel. Acceptance criteria • Floor-area summary table demonstrating compliance with FAR, open-space, and affordable-unit targets. • Dimensioned plans and sections at appropriate studio scales. • Coordinated 3D model delivered in the agreed native format plus IFC or DWG export. • All files named and organized for easy inclusion in my final pin-up boards. If you’re ready to jump in, let’s set milestones for concept refinement, interim review, and final presentation delivery.

opportunities.title: Export MYOB Payslips to Excel
opportunities.description: I’m looking for help pulling all of my MYOB payslip data into a single, tidy Excel workbook. The goal is one Excel file that contains every payslip I’ve issued, lined up row-by-row so I can sort, filter, and run quick reports without jumping back into MYOB each time. Here’s what I need: • A reliable way—whether that’s a script, a short add-in that calls the MYOB API, or a repeatable manual process—to grab the standard payslip fields and drop them into Excel. • The output must be one Excel file with all payslips, not multiple files. • Clear instructions so I can recreate the export whenever new pay runs are completed. If you’ve worked with MYOB (Essentials, AccountRight, or similar) and know your way around Excel automation—VBA, Power Query, or direct API calls—you’re exactly who I’d like to team up with. Let me know how you plan to tackle the export and roughly how long you’ll need.

opportunities.title: Creación Recetas Pupusas Gourmet
opportunities.description: Quiero darle un giro gourmet al plato típico de las pupusas elaborando sabores nuevos que sigan siendo, ante todo, una celebración de lo tradicional. Mi prioridad es desarrollar recetas inéditas basadas en la mejora de los clásicos salvadoreños: partiremos de queso, frijoles y chicharrón y, a la vez, integraremos loroco, ayote, hierbas locales y proteínas especiales como mariscos, pollo o cortes selectos de carne. Necesito tu apoyo para: • Diseñar al menos seis recetas finales que sorprendan al paladar sin perder su identidad. • Incluir por cada receta una ficha técnica clara (gramajes, procesos, tiempos, costos estimados y sugerencia de salsas o maridaje). • Proponer la presentación visual de cada pupusa para que luzca atractiva en el menú. Te entregaré retroalimentación rápida; probaremos las versiones en mi propia cocina hasta afinar texturas y sabores. Acepto cualquier formato de trabajo (Word, Excel, PDF) siempre que sea comprensible para mi equipo. Al finalizar, quiero un recetario digital listo para producción y una tabla de costos por unidad.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40793918, publicado hace 8 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Print-Ready Café Product 3D Models
opportunities.description: 3D Designer Needed: Print-Ready STL and 3MF Files for Café Products (Ongoing Work) About us On The Table (onthetable.shop) is a small business in Northern Ireland. We make custom 3D-printed and engraved essentials for coffee shops and cafés, such as table numbers, QR code stands, table talkers, signs, menu holders and review cards. Every item is personalised to the café's name, logo and colours, so our designs have to be easy to customise. What we need We're looking for a 3D designer to build a library of print-ready product models, plus one-off logo models for customers. Here's the first batch: Table number stand (one standard style and one coffee-bean style) QR code stand and Wi-Fi QR sign Table talker Reserved table sign Menu holder Opening hours sign, allergen sign and dog-friendly sign Order Here and Collect Here signs Staff name badge Café logo coffee stencil Raised 3D logo sign (from a customer's logo; several of these each month) Technical requirements Models must be designed for FDM printing, with the printer, nozzle and filament we use still to be confirmed: [add here]. Every product needs both an STL file and a 3MF file. The 3MF should have multi-colour parts or filament changes set up wherever the design uses two or more colours. Text, numbers and logo areas must be editable or swappable, either as separate bodies or with a parametric source file (Fusion 360, Onshape or OpenSCAD). Designs need to print without supports where possible, sit flat on the bed and fit a 256 × 256 mm build plate. Minimum wall thickness is 1.2 mm, and raised text must be at least 0.8 mm high with lettering readable from 1 metre. Slots and inserts need the right tolerances for the parts that go in them, such as 85 × 55 mm card slots, NFC tags and magnets. The style should be clean, modern and professional, suitable for a café counter or table. Deliverables for each product STL files, plus a 3MF file with the print settings applied The editable source file A rendered preview image Short notes on print orientation and settings Ownership On The Table gets full commercial rights to every file, to sell printed products. You can't resell or share the designs. To apply, please send us A portfolio showing functional or print-ready models you've designed Your CAD software A price for the first batch, and your rate for each one-off logo model How long you'd need Whether you own a 3D printer and test-print your designs

opportunities.title: Diseño de etiquetas elegantes
opportunities.description: Busco un ilustrador con buen dominio de tipografía y composición para crear la línea completa de etiquetas de nuestros perfumes. El estilo debe ser claramente elegante y minimalista, sin ornamentos innecesarios, para resaltar la calidad premium de la marca. Alcance • Diseñar un layout maestro coherente con nuestra identidad visual. • Adaptar ese layout a más de cinco fragancias diferentes, manteniendo unidad gráfica pero con pequeñas variaciones de color o motivo que faciliten la distinción de cada aroma. • Incluir únicamente el nombre del perfume y el logotipo en cada versión; otros datos (ingredientes, código de barras) irán en el estuche, por lo que no se incorporan en esta fase. Entregables 1. Archivo vectorial editable (AI o SVG) del diseño maestro. 2. Versiones finales para cada fragancia en PDF listo para imprenta y PNG de alta resolución para redes. 3. Hoja de especificaciones de color y tipografía. Criterios de aceptación – Estética minimalista y coherente en toda la serie. – Legibilidad perfecta del nombre y del logo a escala de 50 mm. – Uso de colores Pantone o CMYK especificados. Aprecio portafolios que muestren trabajos de packaging o branding con un enfoque limpio y sofisticado.

opportunities.title: Finish Shopify Website
opportunities.description: Shopify Developer Needed ASAP – Complete Existing Website I'm looking for an experienced and affordable Shopify developer to help finish my existing children's Christian entertainment and merchandise website, IMPORTANT: This website is already being developed. I have existing Shopify theme code, page designs, mockups, 3D character illustrations, graphics, icons, and branding. I do NOT need someone to build a website from scratch. Work Required: 1. Complete and polish the homepage and navigation. 2. Finish the family and church membership pages. 3. Create and style the Founders Grove membership presentation and registration pages. 4. Add custom backgrounds, colorful 3D illustrations, buttons, and graphics using my existing assets. 5. Set up merchandise pages for T-shirts, baby onesies, stickers, and future products. 6. Make the website responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop. 7. Fix layout issues and test the website. 8. Prepare membership pages for future subscription and payment integrations. Budget and Schedule: - Hourly rate: $5–$6 USD - Up to 8 hours per day - Project duration: 4–5 working days - Maximum initial labor budget: $240 USD - Must be available to start immediately. Required Skills: Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, Shopify Theme Customization, Ecommerce Development, and Responsive Web Design. Requirements: - Must have previous Shopify development experience. - Must provide examples of completed Shopify websites. - Must communicate regularly and provide daily progress updates. - Must work on a development theme, not the live website. - Must use my existing designs, code, and graphics. - Must get approval before exceeding the agreed hours. - Must explain what can realistically be completed within 40 hours. I'm looking for a reliable developer for this project and potentially ongoing work.

opportunities.title: Comercial B2B para SaaS Clínico
opportunities.description: Comercial freelance B2B para software de clínicas – España | Colaboración a comisión Buscamos un/a comercial freelance o agente comercial autónomo para colaborar en la comercialización de soluciones SaaS de gestión dirigidas a clínicas veterinarias y dentales en España. Se trata de aplicaciones ya desarrolladas y operativas, con demostraciones online disponibles para los candidatos seleccionados. Funciones del colaborador: * Identificar clínicas potencialmente interesadas. * Contactar con responsables y presentar las soluciones. * Realizar demostraciones comerciales online. * Gestionar consultas, seguimiento y negociación. * Cerrar nuevas contrataciones. Qué ofrecemos: * Productos SaaS operativos con suscripciones de 49 a 79 €/mes. * Colaboración flexible y a distancia. * Remuneración exclusivamente mediante comisiones por clientes contratados y pagos efectivamente cobrados. * Sin cuotas fijas ni remuneración por horas. * Material comercial y apoyo técnico para resolver dudas. * Posibilidad de colaboración estable a largo plazo. Perfil buscado: * Experiencia en ventas B2B en España. * Preferiblemente conocimientos o contactos en el sector veterinario, dental o sanitario. * Se valorará especialmente disponer de cartera propia de clínicas. * Capacidad para gestionar el ciclo comercial completo, desde la prospección hasta el cierre. Proceso de selección: En una primera fase valoraremos la experiencia comercial, los sectores en los que trabaja cada candidato y su disponibilidad para colaborar a comisión. A los perfiles preseleccionados se les facilitará información sobre la marca y acceso a las demostraciones públicas para que puedan evaluar el producto por sí mismos. Buscamos una colaboración basada en resultados, no servicios de publicidad, campañas de marketing ni únicamente generación de contactos. Importante: el presupuesto indicado en la plataforma es orientativo. La remuneración se negociará por comisiones sobre ventas efectivamente cobradas, respetando las condiciones de contratación y pago de Freelancer.

opportunities.title: Next.js Migration SEO Recovery Audit
opportunities.description: # Senior Next.js Developer & Technical SEO Expert Needed – Complete Website Migration Audit ## Project Overview I recently migrated my entire website from WordPress to Next.js. The migration is complete, but I am currently experiencing a significant drop in website traffic, along with several technical issues. I am looking for a **highly experienced Next.js developer with strong technical SEO expertise** who can perform a complete, in-depth audit of my entire website, infrastructure, and migration. **I do not want a basic SEO audit or a quick website check. I need someone who will thoroughly investigate the entire system, identify potential migration mistakes, technical problems, performance issues, and SEO-related errors, and help ensure everything is properly configured and functioning as expected.** ## Problems I Have Already Identified **1. Significant Traffic and Ranking Loss** Since migrating from WordPress to Next.js, my website has experienced a noticeable decline in organic traffic. One particularly concerning issue is that some pages are indexed by Google but no longer appear in search results, even for keywords with extremely low competition and very few competing websites. Before the migration, these pages were visible in search results. I need someone to investigate why this is happening and determine whether the migration introduced technical issues affecting crawling, indexing, rendering, or rankings. **2. Handshake Timeout Errors** According to my Sentry error logs, I am experiencing handshake timeout errors. I need a detailed investigation into these errors, including their root causes and potential impact on website availability, performance, and Googlebot accessibility. **3. Potential Migration and Configuration Issues** I want to ensure that absolutely everything was migrated and configured correctly, without any hidden issues that could negatively affect SEO, functionality, or performance. ## Scope of Work – Complete Technical Audit ### 1. Next.js Architecture & Code Review - Review the overall Next.js implementation and architecture. - Verify correct server-side rendering (SSR), static generation (SSG), and rendering strategies where applicable. - Check whether Googlebot can properly access and render all important content. - Identify JavaScript errors, hydration issues, and rendering problems. - Review routing, dynamic pages, middleware, and server configuration. - Identify inefficient implementations, configuration mistakes, and potential bugs. ### 2. Comprehensive Technical SEO Audit - Investigate the organic traffic and ranking decline following the migration. - Analyze why indexed pages are no longer appearing in Google search results. - Review Google Search Console data, indexing reports, and crawl statistics. - Verify robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots directives, and page metadata. - Check HTTP status codes, redirects, 404 errors, soft 404s, and server errors. - Verify that all old WordPress URLs are correctly redirected to their corresponding Next.js URLs. - Check internal linking, page structure, and content accessibility. - Investigate duplicate content and potentially conflicting canonical URLs. - Review structured data and schema markup. - Identify problems that could prevent Googlebot from crawling, rendering, indexing, or ranking pages correctly. ### 3. WordPress-to-Next.js Migration Verification - Verify that all relevant content, URLs, metadata, and SEO elements were transferred correctly. - Compare the previous WordPress URL structure with the new Next.js implementation. - Identify missing pages, broken links, incorrect redirects, and lost SEO signals. - Review potential differences in HTML output and content rendering. - Check whether any migration mistakes could explain the decline in organic visibility. ### 4. Server, Infrastructure & Error Investigation - Investigate the handshake timeout errors reported in Sentry. - Review relevant server logs and application error logs. - Check API requests, database connections, network communication, and timeout configurations. - Identify potential connection, deployment, hosting, or infrastructure issues. - Investigate whether Googlebot or regular visitors may experience intermittent failures. - Verify server stability, response times, and error handling. ### 5. Performance & Core Web Vitals - Analyze loading speed and server response times. - Review Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS). - Identify performance bottlenecks. - Check caching, image optimization, JavaScript delivery, and resource loading. - Verify that the website performs correctly on desktop and mobile devices. ### 6. Complete Website Functionality Testing - Test all important website pages, templates, routes, and functionality. - Identify broken features, unexpected behavior, and frontend/backend errors. - Verify that everything works reliably across different devices and browsers. - Check for any additional technical issues that may have been overlooked. ## Expected Deliverables I expect: 1. **A comprehensive technical audit** covering the entire Next.js website and its migration from WordPress. 2. **A detailed list of all identified issues**, including their severity and potential impact. 3. **Root-cause analysis** of the organic traffic and ranking decline, including any findings that explain why indexed pages are no longer ranking. 4. **A detailed investigation of the Sentry handshake timeout errors.** 5. **Clear technical recommendations and concrete solutions** for all identified problems. 6. **Implementation of necessary fixes**, depending on the agreed project scope. 7. **Verification and testing after fixes** to confirm that the identified technical problems have been resolved. Where possible, findings should be supported by actual technical evidence rather than assumptions. ## Who I Am Looking For I am looking for someone with proven expertise in: - Next.js, React, and modern web architecture - WordPress-to-Next.js migrations - Advanced technical SEO and Google crawling/indexing - Server-side rendering and JavaScript SEO - Google Search Console and organic traffic analysis - Sentry debugging and error investigation - Server infrastructure, APIs, and performance optimization - Debugging complex technical problems in production environments **Important:** This project requires more than standard SEO knowledge. I need someone who understands both the technical development side of Next.js and the SEO implications of migrating a large website from WordPress. My goal is to ensure the entire system is technically sound, stable, optimized for search engines, and free of migration-related problems. Please explain your experience with similar migrations and technical SEO investigations, how you would approach this audit, and what information or access you would need. I am looking for a thorough, systematic investigation — not a superficial review or automated SEO report.

opportunities.title: Rigged 3D Cartoon Dog
opportunities.description: I already have a single reference photo of a cartoon-style dog and I need that exact character brought to life as a fully rigged 3D model. The in-game version must look virtually identical to the picture, so please be confident you can stay on-model while translating the design into three dimensions. Functionality is key: the rig has to allow me to open and close the mouth, blink the eyes, swing the tail, and pose the front and back legs naturally. I will be importing the result into my own game engine, so please deliver a clean, game-ready FBX file with textures included and naming conventions that make sense at first glance. If you prefer Maya, Blender, 3ds Max or similar that’s fine—just be sure the exported FBX comes through intact with all weights and controllers preserved. Keep the geometry efficient (no need for ultra-high poly counts) yet smooth enough for close-ups, and organise the UVs so I can easily swap or tweak textures later. Once we confirm the proportions and style match my reference, we can wrap up; no extra animation clips are required beyond the rig itself. If everything sounds clear, let me know your timeline and we can get started right away.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40793750, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 8 - 30.

opportunities.title: CCTV Coverage Heatmap for Shop
opportunities.description: I already have a complete shop drawing in AutoCAD showing every wall, shelf, and fixture, along with the exact locations and specs for my existing CCTV cameras. What I need now is a clear heat-style overlay that highlights camera coverage across the whole floor plan so I can see at a glance where visibility is strong, where blind spots remain, and how the current layout might be improved. You will start from my DWG (or PDF if you prefer) and use any professional CCTV design tool you are comfortable with—JVSG, AutoCAD add-ins, or equivalent—to generate a colour-graded heatmap. The final file should sit cleanly on top of the existing plan and include a simple legend that explains the intensity scale. Deliverables • Camera-coverage heatmap layered on my original AutoCAD drawing (DWG) • High-resolution PDF export ready for management review • A brief note summarising any blind spots or overlaps you notice I value experience: if you have done similar visualisations before, please mention it and feel free to link a sample.

opportunities.title: 3D Printable Figurine Model
opportunities.description: A detailed 3D model of a decorative figurine is required for direct 3-D printing. The piece will be printed on a consumer-grade FDM and, if the file allows, a resin SLA printer, so clean topology, correct wall thicknesses, and watertight geometry are essential. Here is what I need delivered: • High-resolution, watertight STL (and the native file—Blender, ZBrush, or similar) • Model scaled to 150 mm tall, with a separate base included in the file • Overhangs kept under 45° where possible to minimise supports • No mesh errors: flipped normals, non-manifolds, or intersecting faces I’ll supply a concept sketch and reference photos as soon as the project starts; creative input to add subtle surface detail and character to the figurine is welcome so long as the final file stays print-ready. A short note on print-prep decisions (wall thickness used, support considerations) will complete the hand-off.

opportunities.title: Need to attend a conference in Rome on my behalf
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a freelancer to attend a conference in Rome, Italy, on my behalf. The primary goal of this assignment is to showcase our product. This is a lead generation strategy to bring for future clients. Your responsibilities will include showing the banner to the mass of people present at the event. Who is interested in our product? Just ask to scan the Telegram/WhatsApp/Teams QR given on the banner. Our backend team will be available on those handles, and they will take them forward. The main aim is establishing connections that could lead to future business opportunities. We are looking for a local freelancer in Rome, Italy. who can attend a conference on behalf of our company. You have to take snaps during the event. The conference will be for 2 days; just enjoy the time and have fun. The conference is on 3rd & 4th November 2026. At the end we want the snap you have taken, and a report on the event should be sent by email. The format of the report will be given by us. A person should be frank enough and have good communication. Key tasks include: - Actively networking with potential clients - Distributing prepared networking materials (business cards and brochures) Ideal skills for this job include: - Strong communication and interpersonal skills - Experience in business networking - Ability to represent a company professionally If you have potential and you are interested, please send me a message so that we can discuss... We can also associate for post-event activity also; if performance is great, we can appoint you as country manager further.

opportunities.title: Prospección y Ventas vía WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Busco un profesional enfocado en ventas y atención al cliente que domine las conversaciones por teléfono y, sobre todo, por WhatsApp. Objetivo • Detectar y contactar nuevos prospectos cada día. • Presentar de forma clara nuestros productos o servicios, resolviendo dudas y generando confianza. • Mantener un flujo continuo de información sobre leads, avances y cierres para que podamos medir resultados y optimizar el guion. Qué necesito de tu parte – Experiencia demostrable en ventas telefónicas o vía WhatsApp. – Habilidad para investigar, segmentar y generar tu propia lista inicial de potenciales clientes o aprovechar la base de datos que te proporcionaré. – Capacidad para adaptar el discurso según el tipo de cliente y registrar cada interacción en un sencillo CRM o en una hoja de cálculo compartida. – Seguimiento post-presentación hasta encaminar el cierre o concertar una cita con mi equipo. Entregables esperados 1. Listado semanal de contactos abordados con estado de cada conversación. 2. Reporte de ventas cerradas o citas agendadas. 3. Recomendaciones breves para mejorar guiones, objeciones frecuentes y próximos pasos. Si cuentas con un enfoque proactivo, tino comercial y gusto por abrir mercado, me encantará conocer tu propuesta y la estrategia que aplicarías durante el primer mes.

opportunities.title: Full-Length Film Production Based on an Original Book- Produce Whimsical 3D Animated Feature Film
opportunities.description: I have written an original book of approximately 33,000 words and want to adapt it into a complete film of around 1 hour and 15 minutes. The film should combine live action with predominantly 3D animation, capturing the book’s unique atmosphere, characters, symbolism, and details. **Important: I am looking for bids for the complete finished film, not just a trailer or a selection of scenes.** ### Project Requirements - **Complete film:** Adapt the book into a finished film of approximately 75 minutes, remaining faithful to the original story, important details, hidden clues, and meanings. - **Film structure:** Begin with a live-action introduction, transition into predominantly 3D animation, and conclude with a short live-action sequence. - **Artistic direction:** Develop a distinctive visual style inspired by Golden Age illustrators Gustave Doré, Kay Nielsen, Byam Shaw, Carl Venet, and John Tenniel. The film should feel whimsical, atmospheric, eccentric, and occasionally poignant. Generic AI imagery without careful artistic refinement will not meet the brief. - **Story adaptation:** Review the complete manuscript and create a scene-by-scene plan to ensure important details are represented through animation, dialogue, and narration. Discuss any necessary adaptations with me before proceeding. - **Characters and voices:** I will provide photographs of key characters to guide their live-action appearances and animated designs. Character voices should evoke England around 1820, with narration at appropriate points. - **Music and sound:** Include suitable pastoral English music, dialogue, narration, sound effects, and a polished final audio mix. - **Collaboration:** I require regular editorial input throughout production, including opportunities to review and approve the visual style, character designs, voices, music, and sample scenes. Please outline your review process and revision policy. - **Final delivery:** Supply the complete edited film in an agreed high-quality digital format, with all agreed production elements and applicable usage rights. ### Separate Trailer Requirement Before committing to full production, I require a trailer to confirm that the artistic style, voices, imagery, and atmosphere capture the spirit of the book. Please quote for the trailer separately from the full film and explain what it will include, how revisions will be handled, and whether its cost can be credited toward the full production if we proceed. ### What to Include in Your Bid Please provide: - Your total price for the complete 75-minute film and a separate price for the trailer. - Your proposed production method, tools, and workflow. - A realistic timeline for each major production stage. - Relevant examples of previous animation or film projects. - Details of what is included in your price, any additional costs, and your revision policy. - Confirmation of the rights and ownership arrangements for the finished film and its assets. Please do not submit a bid covering only the trailer or a partial production. I need a clear quotation for delivering the complete film. I am looking for an experienced filmmaker or production team who can bring this book to life with creativity, technical skill, and meticulous attention to detail.

opportunities.title: Junior Interior Designer for Site Coordination
opportunities.description: Role Overview We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Junior Interior Designer who can assist the Senior Interior Design Lead with design development, technical drawings, site coordination, and project implementation. The candidate should be comfortable visiting project sites, communicating with contractors and vendors, monitoring work against approved drawings, and keeping the senior designer informed about progress and issues. When the Senior Interior Designer is unavailable for a site visit, the Junior Interior Designer will act as the design team's on-site representative within the responsibilities assigned to them. Key Responsibilities 1. Design Support • Assist the Senior Interior Design Lead with concepts, mood boards, material selections, and furniture layouts. • Prepare and update 2D drawings and 3D models as required. • Help develop technical drawings, interior elevations, and furniture or cabinetry details. • Maintain updated drawings and records of approved design changes. • Ensure the site team is working from the latest approved drawings. 2. Site Visits & Progress Monitoring • Visit project sites according to the agreed schedule. • Monitor ongoing interior work against approved drawings, specifications, and design intent. • Take site measurements and photographs where required. • Check visible workmanship, material installation, furniture placement, and finishing details. • Identify discrepancies, incomplete work, and potential design issues. • Report progress, delays, and concerns to the Senior Interior Design Lead and founder. 3. Site Team & Vendor Coordination • Communicate approved design instructions to contractors, vendors, and site personnel. • Clarify drawing details within the scope of their knowledge and authority. • Follow up on material deliveries, installation schedules, and pending work. • Coordinate with the senior designer when site conditions differ from the approved design. • Maintain a record of site observations, decisions, and outstanding issues. 4. Reporting & Documentation • Share regular site updates with photographs and concise progress reports. • Maintain a checklist of completed, pending, and defective work. • Document deviations from approved drawings and bring them to the senior designer's attention. • Track issues until the responsible person confirms their resolution. • Assist in preparing snag lists and recording corrections before handover. 5. Design Quality & Finishing Checks • Help ensure that materials, colours, finishes, and installations match approved specifications. • Pay attention to alignment, dimensions, joints, edges, fittings, and finishing quality. • Flag visible defects and deviations before work progresses further. • Assist with final walkthroughs and handover documentation when required. Required Skills & Qualifications • Diploma or degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or a related field preferred. • 1–3 years of relevant experience in interior design or site coordination preferred. • Basic proficiency in AutoCAD and familiarity with SketchUp or other 3D software. • Ability to read and interpret interior design drawings. • Understanding of interior materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, and installation processes. • Strong observation, organisation, communication, and problem-solving skills. • Willingness to travel to project sites in New Delhi as required. • Ability to prepare clear reports, maintain records, and follow up consistently. Important Working Expectations • Follow the approved design and instructions from the Senior Interior Design Lead. • Do not independently change approved layouts, materials, specifications, or design details without authorisation. • Escalate technical uncertainties, major discrepancies, and unexpected site conditions promptly. • Do not approve additional costs, variations, or contractor commitments without the required authorisation. • Maintain professional conduct with clients, vendors, contractors, and other team members. • Work within the assigned responsibilities and follow the company's project documentation and reporting procedures.

Site Visits & Progress Monitoring • Visit project sites according to the agreed schedule. • Monitor ongoing interior work against approved drawings, specifications, and design intent. • Take site measurements and photographs where required. • Check visible workmanship, material installation, furniture placement, and finishing details. • Identify discrepancies, incomplete work, and potential design issues. • Report progress, delays, and concerns to the Senior Interior Design Lead and founder. 3. opportunities.title: Comercial a comisión para vender devoluciones de Amazon a tiendas y mayoristas (España)
opportunities.description: Somos Reusalia, una empresa de Valencia que vende devoluciones de Amazon a profesionales: cajas, palés y camiones completos. Cada lote lleva su listado artículo a artículo, con el valor de cada cosa en Amazon. Hay hogar, menaje, niños, motor, bricolaje y electrónica. Buscamos un comercial que consiga clientes NUEVOS en España: bazares, tiendas de segunda mano, puestos de mercadillo, tiendas online, mayoristas y compradores de stock. CÓMO COBRAS - Solo comisión, sin sueldo fijo. - Cobras por lo que compran los clientes que consigas, también por lo que repitan. - Se cobra una vez al mes, por lo que tus clientes ya han pagado. - Las condiciones exactas las hablamos contigo. QUÉ TE DAMOS - Contactos para empezar: tiendas que encajan y personas que ya se han interesado por nuestros lotes. - Teléfono con WhatsApp Business y correo de la empresa. - Un enlace personal: las ventas que salen de él se te apuntan solas. - El catálogo siempre al día, con fotos y listados. QUÉ BUSCAMOS - Experiencia vendiendo a tiendas o mayoristas. Mejor si conoces los saldos, el stock, el bazar o la ferretería. - Español nativo o perfecto, y soltura al teléfono y por WhatsApp. - Que trabajes como autónomo y organices tu tiempo. No hay horario. - Que trabajes contacto a contacto. Nada de envíos masivos. PARA PRESENTARTE Empieza tu propuesta con la palabra STOCK y contesta en pocas líneas: 1. Qué has vendido antes, a quién y cuánto al mes. 2. A qué tiendas o compradores llegas hoy (zona y sector). 3. Cómo conseguirías tus 5 primeros clientes.

Buscamos un editor de vídeo con IA para trabajar con nosotros a largo plazo, no para un proyecto suelto. Qué buscamos: Experiencia real con Nano Banana, Magnific, Higgsfield, Seedance y Kling (varias de ellas). Dominar varios formatos: vsl, ugc, animación estilo pixar, claymation, podcast, talking head y pizarra animada. Iniciativa: eliges la herramienta adecuada sin que te lleven de la mano. Mentalidad de respuesta directa: el objetivo es vender, no que quede bonito. Si quieres subir de nivel con la IA y ganar según tus resultados, esto es para ti. Si no puedes enseñar el proyecto, no cuenta. Empieza tu propuesta con la palabra “MANGO”. Sin ella o sin el Loom, no se revisa. opportunities.title: Comercial con el español como lengua materna
opportunities.description: Busco un comercial cuya lengua materna sea el español para impulsar la venta de un producto físico dirigido, sobre todo, a pequeñas y medianas empresas. La prioridad inmediata es ampliar la base de contactos mediante llamadas telefónicas efectivas; una vez generados los leads, pasaremos a las visitas presenciales y al cierre de las oportunidades que encajen. Qué me interesa lograr contigo • Un flujo constante de nuevos prospectos verificados por teléfono. • Reuniones concertadas y reportadas en mi CRM. • Seguimiento hasta el cierre de cada operación, incluyendo el feedback necesario para afinar el discurso de ventas. Entregables mínimos 1. Listado semanal de leads contactados, con nombre de empresa, persona decisora y estado de la conversación. 2. Agenda de visitas confirmadas (presenciales o virtuales). 3. Informe quincenal de oportunidades abiertas y ventas cerradas. Si disfrutas abriendo puertas por teléfono y dominas la venta consultiva en español, estaré encantado de colaborar contigo.

Necesito: • Diseño del flujo conversacional: saludo inicial, mensajes fuera de horario y contestaciones para las dudas más comunes. • Redacción de cada mensaje con tono profesional y cercano. • Configuración técnica paso a paso, ya sea desde la app Business, WhatsApp Web o mediante una integración con la API oficial, Twilio, ManyChat u otra solución que recomiendes. • Pruebas en tiempo real y ajustes hasta que el sistema funcione sin fallos. Cuando todo esté listo, espero un pequeño documento con capturas o video corto donde se muestre cómo modificar textos y horarios por mi cuenta. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y dar feedback durante todo el proceso, así que avancemos tan pronto como sea posible."

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de tienda online
opportunities.description: Necesito que construyan una tienda en línea para vender productos físicos que se envían a domicilio. El sitio debe ser claro, rápido y adaptarse a dispositivos móviles. Lo esencial que requiero: • Carrito de compra con pagos en línea completamente funcional (tarjetas, PayPal u otras pasarelas populares). • Panel de administración que permita cargar productos, fotos y descripciones, así como crear categorías. • Control de inventario con alertas automáticas de stock bajo para que nunca se agoten artículos sin previo aviso. • Sección de cuenta de usuario donde los clientes puedan revisar compras anteriores y el estado de sus pedidos. • Estructura optimizada para SEO básico y tiempos de carga rápidos. Aporto el logo, la paleta de colores y las imágenes de producto; tú te encargas de la instalación, la configuración inicial y una breve guía de uso para que yo pueda continuar gestionando la tienda por mi cuenta. Trabajo con plazos realistas, pero necesito una solución lista para lanzar. Si ya has creado e-commerce con WooCommerce, Quedo atento a tu propuesta y ejemplos de tiendas que hayas realizado.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40792208, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.
